caption: The drawing depicts a single vertical object positioned centrally on the page, within a larger outlined rectangle. The object has four tall, narrow, cylindrical columns grouped closely together and fusing into a single structure, each column ending in a pointed tip at the top. These columns are arranged upright on a rectangular base with a visible beveled edge. The object is shaded in tones of gray and black, giving it a metallic appearance. There are circular marks and a small protruding rectangular piece on one of the cylinders near the base. The background is an unadorned, light beige color, and all lines, including the large rectangle enclosing the central composition, are rendered in a fine dark pencil or ink. There is a faint stain or mark at the top edge above the outlined area.
title: Candle Mold
